candidates.reason: Primary test module for scrapy.utils.response.open_in_browser. It holds both ReDoS guards (test_open_in_browser_redos_comment, test_open_in_browser_redos_head) and their shared helper _assert_open_in_browser_is_fast, which decides pass/fail with a fixed 0.2s process_time() budget and uses the comment-removal exploit input that the current implementation never evaluates. The same module contains all the open_in_browser behaviour tests (base-tag injection after a doctype, comment preservation, base-URL preservation, .txt extension, unsupported-type TypeError) that must keep passing.

Integration surface for the same helper: the `scrapy view` command calls open_in_browser on a real fetched response (scrapy/commands/view.py:28), so TestViewCommand exercises the body rewriting and temp-file writing path end to end and would surface a behaviour regression introduced while reworking the ReDoS guard.
